impl_requirements: Emit a complete, self-contained source file the CPU toolchain can build into a shared object (.so). Default toolchains: g++/clang++ for .cpp/.cc, gcc/clang for .c. If your source needs a non-default command, pass it via build.sh --build-cmd. Do NOT rely on any vendor SDK (CUDA/ROCm/CANN/Metal) — this is the generic fallback for a backend with no native driver.
read_metric_guide: The generic substrate has NO vendor profiler: dram_pct, sm_pct and occupancy are always null and diagnose.py will classify the bottleneck as 'unknown'. Optimize on wall-clock latency alone — rank changes by measured end-to-end speedup, not by counter-derived guidance (there is none). This is enough to drive any latency-optimizing search / evolution / refinement method; it cannot drive a method that fundamentally needs hardware counters.
